author: IGN
description: In Disney and Pixar's Hoppers, Mabel (Piper Curda) uses a technology called "Hoppers" to "hop" into the body of a beaver. Bobby Moynihan and Jeffrey Vega from IGN obtained access to this technology right before this interview and switched places to see if anyone would notice. Did Piper Curda, Jon Hamm, and Dave Franco figure out the truth? Only one way to find out...
title: Bobby Moynihan "Hops" Into IGN Host For Hoppers Interview

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Microsoft held a talk at this year's Game Developers Conference where they gave a very brief overview of what to expect from the next-gen Xbox hardware, codenamed Project Helix. The console is confirmed to be able to play PC and Xbox games, and will be powered by a custom AMD SoC. They also teased a look at the Xbox Developer Kit, or XDK. In other news, Fortnites original story-focused Save the World mode will go free-to-play for the first time in April. The mode is what Fortnite was all about before the Battle Royale mode was added a few months later and subsequently changed the gaming industry forever. And finally, original Resident Evil 2 director Hideki Kamiya wants Capcom to add a 'non-scary' mode to Resident Evil Requiem, since he just wants to do puzzles and combat.
title: Xbox Posts "Sneak Peek" of Project Helix Next-Gen Console Hardware - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Meet Ishida and learn about this character in this latest Shadow of the Road trailer for the upcoming tactical RPG. Shadow of the Road will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG). A demo is out now on Steam.

Ishida “the Boulder” is an impenetrable bastion on the battlefield, protecting his partners both by drawing the enemy’s ire and by dishing out huge amounts of damage. His headbutts, bear hugs, fearless charges, and swings of his gigantic nōdachi spell doom not just for human enemies, but also for yōkai and mechs. He’s quick to start fights, especially under the influence of sake, and quick to end them — violently. However, despite his short fuse, he is also a warmhearted epicurean and loyal friend.

#ign #gaming
title: Shadow of the Road - Official Ishida Trailer

description:
Check out this trailer for DEFECT, an upcoming tactical shooter from EmptyVessel, a team made up of former Call of Duty, Doom and The Last of Us developers and published by NC America. The world of DEFECT is dark and dystopian, with a divisive and enigmatic AI called "The System" in charge. Players can hone their skills in an offline environment, or join up co-operatively for 4v4v4v4 PvP squads featuring explosive, close-quarter firefights featuring dynamic multi-objective battles with advanced weapons and tech.

description:
Watch the latest Sengoku Dynasty trailer for this open-world RPG with settlement-building and survival elements to see what's coming with the free Kanata update, which brings new content, including various gameplay additions and improvements. The Kanata update introduces a new subtropical archipelago with three distinct regions, new animals, new plants, extra player animations, bell tower upgrades, and a new enemy faction: pirates. The Kanata update for Sengoku Dynasty launches on PC on March 12, 2026.

A 4-player co-op experience that has elements of survival games, base defense and of course: ZOMBIES! 

Fortnite Save The World goes free-to-play on April 16th.

author: IGN
description:
Join Doug Bradley (voice of Pinhead) and the team at Saber Interactive and Boss Team Games for a behind-the-scenes look into Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival in this new video for the upcoming survival-horror action game. The team discusses the origins, story, and challenges in bringing the iconic universe to life in the video game. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

Embark on a battle for survival against Hell’s armies with a terrifying new story in the Hellraiser universe in Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival. Descend into the darkest depths of the underworld to rescue your love from an eternal realm of torment at the hands of the depraved Cenobites. Face your deepest fears against Hell’s most deviant wretches, cultists and creatures with the infernal powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box and an arsenal of earthly weapons.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Official 'Origins' Developer Diary
